The '''''Mutilator''''' was a [[YZ-775 medium transport]] that was owned by [[Gilflyn]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CCW" />
